changelog: v0.7.1: 1) Authentic Human Speech TTS on PC Server: replaces synthetic harmonic tone generator with genuine Windows System.Speech synthesis (16-bit 22050Hz PCM WAV) featuring natural phoneme intonation, pitch variation, and gender matching; 2) Non-Blocking Speech-to-Text Multi-Threading: decoupled VU meter UI DOM updates via requestAnimationFrame and cooperative event-loop yielding before/after audio resampling; 3) Quest 3 / PC Remote STT Offloading: routes microphone audio directly to PC Server /api/stt in remote mode to reduce headset CPU to 0% during transcription; 4) Quest 3 Split Architecture Automated Verification Suite.
